name: Promptclay
description: Promptclay is a free library of AI image prompts that anyone can copy. Each prompt is shown with an example image so you can see the result before you use it. Prompts are organised into themed collections such as portraits and poses, pet photos, collages and photography styles. Copy a prompt with one click and paste it into the image generator you already use, such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Gemini or other tools. Promptclay is built by Yash Patidar for creators, designers and marketers who want good results without writing prompts from scratch.
